analysis.evidence: וַיְהִי introduces the episode impersonally. The כַּאֲשֶׁר clause sets the time, as Abram drew near to Egypt, and וַיֹּאמֶר gives the main event, his speech to Sarai.
analysis.morphology: The prefixed conjunction וַ introduces יְהִי, the short third-person masculine singular Qal form of הָיָה, in a wayyiqtol construction.

analysis.morphology: Relative particle with prefixed comparative preposition כַּ.
analysis.sense: with a preposition: as, where, than, until

analysis.evidence: In כַּאֲשֶׁר הִקְרִיב לָבוֹא מִצְרָיְמָה, Abram himself draws near. The infinitive phrase לָבוֹא מִצְרָיְמָה specifies what he is close to doing, entering Egypt.
analysis.morphology: Hiphil perfect, third person masculine singular, with Abram as the subject.
